groups.name: stratum
groups.description: Settings that several Stratum modules share.

properties.name: stratum.environment
properties.description: The environment the service runs in, such as prod. The logging module writes it as service.environment and the observability module tags every metric and span with it.

properties.name: stratum.context-propagation.async-threads
properties.description: Whether @Async methods and work on Spring Boot's executors keep the trace and workflow fields of the code that started them. Used by the logging and observability modules when they are on. Sets Spring Boot's spring.task.execution.propagate-context, which wins if the service sets it. When the service's own pool beans stop Spring Boot from creating its task executor, Stratum creates that executor and points @Async methods at it.

properties.name: stratum.context-propagation.reactor
properties.description: Whether log lines written in every Reactor operator, such as map, flatMap and doOnNext, and in WebFlux handlers keep the trace, correlation ID and workflow fields, and WebClient sends the correlation ID on. Used by the logging and observability modules when they are on. Sets Spring Boot's spring.reactor.context-propagation to auto (true) or limited (false), which wins if the service sets it.

properties.name: stratum.context-propagation.executor-beans
properties.description: Whether the pool beans the service declares as Executor, ExecutorService or ScheduledExecutorService are wrapped, so that their tasks keep the trace, correlation ID, workflow fields and the service's own MDC fields of the code that submitted them. A bean declared as a class, such as ThreadPoolExecutor, is not wrapped. Used by the logging and observability modules when they are on.
